instructions: Read the primary source in full. A technically successful full-text fetch is not sufficient when tables, appendices, or other evidence needed for the five slots are missing; continue through the ordered official full-text routes and use the next route only to fill the missing primary evidence. selection_reason: On-demand visual memory selection reduces redundant visual context processing in multimodal reasoning, a plausible inference-time compute and context-efficiency mechanism.
title: Look Back, Think Ahead: Visual Memory on Demand for Efficient Multimodal Reasoning
